places: unnamed elevation 2.8 km southeast of Nepen Diaka

fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid; rainy season (May to November) has strong southeast winds; dry season (December to April) dominated by hot, dry, harmattan wind
fields.terrain: generally low, rolling, plains rising to foothills in southeast
fields.farm: rice, groundnuts, watermelons, millet, cassava, sugarcane, maize, sorghum, onions, milk
fields.exports: gold, refined petroleum, phosphoric acid, fish, cement
fields.industries: agricultural and fish processing, phosphate mining, fertilizer production, petroleum refining, zircon, and gold mining, construction materials, ship construction and repair
fields.languages: French (official), Wolof, Pulaar, Jola, Mandinka, Serer, Soninke
fields.religions: Muslim 97.2% (most adhere to one of the four main Sufi brotherhoods), Christian 2.7% (mostly Roman Catholic)
fields.legal: civil law system based on French law; Constitutional Council reviews legislative acts
fields.military: 18-28 (up to 35 for specialized roles); 24-month service commitment
